news.title: Trump says U.S. to ban large investors from buying homes
news.description: "I am immediately taking steps to ban large institutional investors from buying more single-family homes," Trump said.

news.title: ICE agents fatally shoot woman in Minneapolis, DHS says
news.description: A video shows ICE agents approaching a woman in a car on a Minneapolis street and telling her to exit the vehicle. She was shot as she pulls away.

news.title: Rubio says he will meet with Denmark about Greenland next week
news.description: Greenland is a self-governing territory of Denmark, a NATO ally of the United States. That has not stopped President Trump from saying he wants the island.
